title: Fufu Gabonais
description: Fufu Gabonais is a Gabon classic prepared with cassava flour, plantain flour, peanut sauce. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 9 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Slowly stir the grains into the simmering liquid; cook over low heat for about 21 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 12 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
